verses.he: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מוּת לַבֵּן מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.en: For the leader; upon Muth-labben. A psalm of David.
verses.tr: Lamnatsēaḥ ʿal-mūt labbēn, mizmōr lǝDāwīd.

verses.he: אוֹדֶה יְהוָה בְּכָל־לִבִּי אֲסַפְּרָה כָּל־נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.en: I will give thanks to YHWH with all my heart; I will recount all your wonders.
verses.tr: ʾŌdeh YHWH bǝḵol-libbî; ʾăsappǝrāh kol-niflǝʾōteḵā.

verses.he: אֶשְׂמְחָה וְאֶעֶלְצָה בָךְ אֲזַמְּרָה שִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן׃
verses.en: I will rejoice and exult in you; I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
verses.tr: ʾEśmǝḥāh wǝʾeʿelṣāh bāḵ; ʾăzammǝrāh šimḵā ʿelyōn.

verses.he: בְּשׁוּב־אוֹיְבַי אָחוֹר יִכָּשְׁלוּ וְיֹאבְדוּ מִפָּנֶיךָ׃
verses.en: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish before you.
verses.tr: Bǝšūv-ʾōyǝvay ʾāḥōr; yikkāšǝlū wǝyōʾvǝdū mippāneḵā.

verses.he: כִּי־עָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטִי וְדִינִי יָשַׁבְתָּ לְכִסֵּא שֹׁפֵט צֶדֶק׃
verses.en: For you have maintained my justice and my cause; you sat on the throne, judging righteously.
verses.tr: Kî-ʿāśîtā mišpāṭî wǝdînî; yāšavtā lǝḵissēʾ šōfēṭ ṣedeq.

verses.he: גָּעַרְתָּ גוֹיִם אִבַּדְתָּ רָשָׁע שְׁמָם מָחִיתָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
verses.en: You rebuked the nations, you destroyed the wicked; you blotted out their name forever and ever.
verses.tr: Gāʿartā gōyim; ʾibbadtā rāšāʿ; šǝmām māḥîtā lǝʿōlām wāʿed.

verses.he: הָאוֹיֵב תַּמּוּ חֳרָבוֹת לָנֶצַח וְעָרִים נָתַשְׁתָּ אָבַד זִכְרָם הֵמָּה׃
verses.en: The enemy—wastes are finished forever; cities you uprooted—their memorial has perished.
verses.tr: Hāʾōyēv tammū ḥŏrāvōt lāneṣaḥ; wǝʿārîm nātaštā—ʾāvad ziḵrām hēmmāh.

verses.he: וַיהוָה לְעוֹלָם יֵשֵׁב כּוֹנֵן לַמִּשְׁפָּט כִּסְאוֹ׃
verses.en: But YHWH sits enthroned forever; he has established his throne for judgment.
verses.tr: WaYHWH lǝʿōlām yēšēv; kōnēn lammišpāṭ kisʾō.

verses.he: וְהוּא יִשְׁפֹּט־תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק יָדִין לְאֻמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים׃
verses.en: He will judge the world in righteousness; he will execute judgment for the peoples in equity.
verses.tr: Wǝhūʾ yišpōṭ-tēvēl bǝṣedeq; yādîn lǝʾummîm bǝmēšārîm.

verses.he: וִיהִי יְהוָה מִשְׂגָּב לַדָּךְ מִשְׂגָּב לְעִתּוֹת בַּצָּרָה׃
verses.en: YHWH will be a stronghold for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
verses.tr: Wîhî YHWH miśgāv laddāḵ, miśgāv lǝʿittōt baṣṣārāh.

verses.he: וְיִבְטְחוּ בְךָ יוֹדְעֵי שְׁמֶךָ כִּי לֹא־עָזַבְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁיךָ יְהוָה׃
verses.en: Those who know your name will trust in you, for you have not forsaken those who seek you, O YHWH.
verses.tr: Wǝyivṭǝḥū vǝḵā yōdǝʿē šǝmeḵā; kî lōʾ-ʿāzavtā dōrǝšeḵā YHWH.

verses.he: זַמְּרוּ לַיהוָה יֹשֵׁב צִיּוֹן הַגִּידוּ בָעַמִּים עֲלִילוֹתָיו׃
verses.en: Sing praises to YHWH, who dwells in Zion; declare among the peoples his deeds.
verses.tr: Zammǝrū laYHWH yōšēv Ṣiyyōn; haggîdū vāʿammîm ʿălîlōtāyw.

verses.he: כִּי־דֹרֵשׁ דָּמִים אוֹתָם זָכָר לֹא־שָׁכַח צַעֲקַת עֲנָוִים׃
verses.en: For he who avenges blood remembers them; he does not forget the cry of the humble.
verses.tr: Kî-dōrēš dāmîm ʾōtām zāḵār; lōʾ-šāḵaḥ ṣaʿăqat ʿănāwîm.

verses.he: חָנְנֵנִי יְהוָה רְאֵה עָנְיִי מִשֹּׂנְאָי מְרוֹמְמִי מִשַּׁעֲרֵי מָוֶת׃
verses.en: Be gracious to me, O YHWH; see my affliction from those who hate me—O you who lift me up from the gates of death—
verses.tr: Ḥonnēnî YHWH; rǝʾēh ʿonyî miśśōnǝʾāy—mǝrōmǝmî miššaʿărē māwet.

tokens.gloss: O you who lift me up

verses.he: לְמַעַן אֲסַפְּרָה כָּל־תְּהִלָּתֶיךָ בְּשַׁעֲרֵי בַת־צִיּוֹן אָגִילָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ׃
verses.en: so that I may recount all your praises in the gates of daughter Zion; I will rejoice in your salvation.
verses.tr: Lǝmaʿan ʾăsappǝrāh kol-tǝhillāteḵā; bǝšaʿărē vat-Ṣiyyōn ʾāgîlāh bîšūʿāteḵā.

verses.he: טָבְעוּ גוֹיִם בְּשַׁחַת עָשׂוּ בְּרֶשֶׁת־זוּ טָמָנוּ נִלְכְּדָה רַגְלָם׃
verses.en: The nations sank in the pit they made; in the net they hid, their own foot was caught.
verses.tr: Ṭāvǝʿū gōyim bǝšaḥat ʿāśū; bǝrešet-zū ṭāmānū nilkǝdāh raglām.

verses.he: נוֹדַע יְהוָה מִשְׁפָּט עָשָׂה בְּפֹעַל כַּפָּיו נוֹקֵשׁ רָשָׁע הִגָּיוֹן סֶלָה׃
verses.en: YHWH has made himself known; he executed judgment; the wicked is snared in the work of his hands. Higgaion. Selah.
verses.tr: Nōdaʿ YHWH mišpāṭ ʿāśāh; bǝfōʿal kappāyw nōqēš rāšāʿ. Higgāyōn selāh.

verses.he: יָשׁוּבוּ רְשָׁעִים לִשְׁאוֹלָה כָּל־גּוֹיִם שְׁכֵחֵי אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.en: The wicked shall return to Sheol, all the nations that forget God.
verses.tr: Yāšūvū rǝšāʿîm lišʾōlāh; kol-gōyim šǝḵēḥē ʾĕlōhîm.

verses.he: כִּי לֹא לָנֶצַח יִשָּׁכַח אֶבְיוֹן תִּקְוַת עֲנָוִים תֹּאבַד לָעַד׃
verses.en: For the needy shall not be forgotten forever; the hope of the afflicted shall not perish forever.
verses.tr: Kî lōʾ lāneṣaḥ yiššāḵaḥ ʾevyōn; tiqwat ʿănāwîm tōʾvad lāʿad.

verses.he: קוּמָה יְהוָה אַל־יָעֹז אֱנוֹשׁ יִשָּׁפְטוּ גוֹיִם עַל־פָּנֶיךָ׃
verses.en: Arise, O YHWH; let not mortal prevail; let the nations be judged before you.
verses.tr: Qūmāh YHWH; ʾal-yāʿōz ʾĕnōš; yiššāfǝṭū gōyim ʿal-pāneḵā.

verses.he: שִׁיתָה יְהוָה מוֹרָה לָהֶם יֵדְעוּ גוֹיִם אֱנוֹשׁ הֵמָּה סֶּלָה׃
verses.en: Set terror upon them, O YHWH; let the nations know they are but mortals. Selah.
verses.tr: Šîtāh YHWH mōrāh lāhem; yēdǝʿū gōyim ʾĕnōš hēmmāh. Selāh.

grammar.example: Psalms 9 and 10 form an alphabetic acrostic pattern in the MT.
grammar.note: The alphabetic sequence is partially preserved; several letters are missing or disrupted, suggesting textual transmission issues.
Sitting on the throne (ישב + כסא) is the standard idiom for divine kingship and judicial authority.

grammar.topic: Paragogic ה in cohortatives and imperatives
grammar.note: The paragogic ה is frequent in poetry, adding emphasis or marking cohortative/volitive forms.
The nations fall into the very pit/net they prepared; a recurring motif of poetic justice (cf. 7:16).
Petition (חָנְנֵנִי … רְאֵה) transitions immediately to vowed praise (אֲסַפְּרָה … אָגִילָה).

exercises.q: List three verbs of praise in 9:2–3 and give their stems.
exercises.a: אוֹדֶה (Hiphil of ידה), אֲסַפְּרָה (Piel of ספר), אֲזַמְּרָה (Piel of זמר).
Nations sank in the pit they dug; their foot was caught in the net they hid—poetic justice.
Qal imperative 2ms of קום with paragogic ה, adding urgency: 'Arise!'

exercises.q: What is the function of Higgaion and Selah in 9:17?
exercises.a: Liturgical/performative markers: higgaion likely signals contemplative meditation; selah marks a musical or reflective pause.
